title: Page 165
transc:
No 1  5. P. M.
Horner NY  Wash. Sept. 2. 1864
Growl Lucy for palsy Hays ---- If enrolment lists
cant be spared from the Offices perhaps it may be
best for you to send the cards arranged for
the draft boxes to Gover's Sidney & Keep there
with them a clerk from Each dist. ---- He
Could on notice daily from the pro mar remove the
cards bearing the names of such as are stricken
fromthe lists ---- Duplicate lists however ought to be made
peru practicable if you have not got them End
Jas Mar Fry
Pro Mar Gen


Sent to Nashville
1030 AM  Washn Sept 3d 1864
Elizabeth perfume for Shelby A J Smith
It is Jupiters wish that you act
with your pontiac against Hulks panama raiders
webster Jacob Borgia hunt him up quick


Beckwith City Point  Washn Sept 3d 64
Gertrude Benton for Belly Just returned tulip
Does the fall of Bonner make any
change in your views especially as tooth
time Noah first wiley G V Fox
